title: Kepler.gl — temporal WMS

options.content:
## A temporal WMS with no infrastructure at all

The query is a TestData frame of **one single row**: the service and the layer. Not one date.

The calendar comes from the service. A layer with a `TIME` dimension publishes every pass it holds in its GetCapabilities, and the panel reads them from there to build the clock's axis — so **drag the map's time bar** and the image changes day, with no data source, no ETL and no tile server.

If the query brings a time column of its own, that one wins. This panel shows the other half of the bargain: when it does not, the service knows its own dates better than anyone.

**Click on the rainfall** and the pixel's value appears above, under "Value under the click". A `-99` is what this product uses for "no data", not a failure.
